rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something by intuition rather than through training or deliberate planning.

example.english: I intuitively chose this route, and it turned out to be much faster.
example.traditional: 我靠直覺揀咗呢條路，結果真係快好多。
example.jyutping: ngo5 kaau3 zik6 gok3 gaan2 zo2 ne1 tiu4 lou6 git3 gwo2 zan1 hai6 faai3 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this when the action is driven specifically by an innate instinct or reflex, rather than by a considered intuition.

example.english: When the ball came flying at me, I intuitively reached out and caught it.
example.traditional: 見到個波飛埋嚟，我靠本能伸手接住。
example.jyutping: gin3 dou2 go3 bo1 fei1 maai4 lai4 ngo5 kaau3 bun2 nang4 san1 sau2 zip3 zyu6
